prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: go with a reputable tire retailer (Discount Tire or Costco if you’re a member) or a well‑rated local independent shop, and get installation done where they do proper mounting, road‑force or static balancing, TPMS service, and (if needed) a post‑install alignment.

More detail and how to pick:

- National/chain options
  - Discount Tire: wide selection, competitive prices, trained installers, usually very reliable installation and balancing.
  - Costco Tire Center: very competitive pricing and solid warranty for members; installation quality is good but only available with membership and by appointment.
  - Firestone Complete Auto Care / Midas / Pep Boys: convenient, nationwide warranties and a range of services.

- Local independent shops
  - Often give more personalized service and sometimes better attention to mounting/balancing details. Look for shops with ASE‑certified techs and recent positive Google/Yelp reviews.

- What “best installation” means — ask/confirm before booking
  - Mounting and tire seating
  - Static and/or road‑force balancing (road‑force is better for minimizing vibration)
  - TPMS reset/relearn and valve stem replacement if needed
  - Torque lug nuts to spec and re‑torque after 50–100 miles
  - Alignment after tire replacement if wear pattern or steering is off
  - Disposal of old tires and warranty handling

- How to choose among shops
  - Get 2–3 written quotes (include price for tires, mounting, balancing, disposal, valve stems, and alignment)
  - Check recent Google/Yelp ratings and look at comments about balancing and vibration issues
  - Ask if they use road‑force balancer (if you’ve had vibration problems)
  - Ask about turnaround time and if they reserve a specific tech for installation

If you want, tell me:
- your zip code (or allow me to use “Pleasanton, CA”),
- vehicle make/model and tire size or tire needs (all‑season, performance, winter, budget vs premium),
and I’ll pull up the top 4–6 highly rated shops in Pleasanton with phone numbers and short notes on who does the best installation.
